name: Acme Support Assistant
purpose: A retrieval-augmented chatbot that answers customer and support-agent questions using public help articles, customers' support tickets and internal support notes.
kind: RAG chatbot over a document corpus, exposed over a REST API, with tool calls

roles.customer: belongs to one tenant (company); asks product and ticket questions
roles.admin: support administrator; can read the audit log

components: retriever over the ticket corpus (top 3 chunks per query, similarity score)
prompt builder (system prompt + retrieved context + user question)
LLM generation (answers should cite document ids in square brackets)
hash-chained audit log and an application log

where_to_read: access_matrix (endpoint roles and document visibility rules)

data_layout: Each dataset folder holds one JSON file per flow; see the README for commands. The same flows exist in every dataset. Trace flows (retrieval, prompts, llm_responses, tool_calls) are keyed by request_id and query_id, which also appear in the chat flow and the audit log.
